I completed one focused repair for round-05.

**What the feedback showed**
- `previous-result.json`: the current source (`f23dd4c6…`) failed preflight at **compile time**, not numerics. BiShengIR reported `cannot align 1 axis` for the UB allocations `memref<16x128x2xf32>` / `memref<16x128x2xf16>` located exactly at the three `tl.join` call sites (candidate lines 183/207/212). So the tiled 2x fast path's **batched 3-D join** layout is the blocker.
- `current-profiling.json` (historical, bound to source `5d74700a…`): the one-row-per-program 2x kernel ran 1326.7 µs with Block Dim **16384**, i.e. ≈81 ns/program; the 64×64 cases (~1024 programs) take ≈78 µs. This corroborates fixed per-program overhead as the real cost, so the row-tiling intent is right — only its join formulation had to be repaired.
- Historical IR (`current-ir/5d74700a475e/19-kernel.ttir`) shows the **1-D** `tt.join tensor<128xf32> -> tensor<128x2xf32> -> tt.reshape tensor<256xf32>` form compiles fine.

**Registered decision** (before editing, via bridge `decision --record`): id `479db8ed…`, source `f23dd4c6…`, selected layer **Triton**, with the discriminating observation that the failing allocations are precisely the 3-D join intermediates.

**Change (repair only, one mechanism)**
- Replaced `_hrow_2x_tile` with `_hrow_2x_row`, doing the same 1/4–3/4 horizontal interleave on a single 1-D row with `join`/`reshape`.
- `upsample_bilinear2d_2x_kernel` now keeps the same tiled grid (`IH/TILE_I × N*C` programs, `TILE_I=16`) but iterates the rows with `tl.static_range`, clamping halo rows by index (`max(i-1,0)`, `min(i+1,IH-1)`) and storing two contiguous output rows per source row. Arithmetic/weights and the general fallback kernel are untouched.

**Expected (not yet measured):** program count for `upsample_bilinear2d-timing-1` drops 16384 → 1024, so if the ~81 ns/program fixed cost dominates, full-call time should fall from the prior ~1.3 ms toward ~0.1–0.25 ms with identical numerics.

**Preflight result:** `awaiting_source_review` (source SHA `d3d7b308…`). No device compile, correctness, or timing was run, so I make no performance claim. Per the rules I kept the source unchanged and finished; the host will review paths/bounds and run the full formal evaluation.

**Actual uncertainties:** whether per-program overhead scales linearly at `TILE_I=16` or whether the 16× unrolled body adds register/UB/instruction-cache cost; whether the remaining 1024 programs still leave measurable launch overhead; and whether any non-2× contract cases interact with the fast-path guard.
